rules.name: Sensitive Columns Must Have Dynamic Data Masking
rules.description: Returns sensitive column names not masked according to keyword pattern. WARNING: This rule was AI-generated and is untested.

sqlquery: SELECT c.name FROM sys.columns c LEFT JOIN sys.masked_columns mc ON c.object_id = mc.object_id AND c.column_id = mc.column_id WHERE (LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%email%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%salary%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%phone%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%dob%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%creditcard%') AND ISNULL(mc.is_masked,0)=0
